description: A professional skincare routine tailored for acne-prone skin, designed to gently cleanse, tone, and protect the skin while minimizing breakouts.

morning_steps.purpose: To remove excess oils and impurities without stripping natural skin moisture.

morning_steps.action: Gently pat on a hydrating toner
morning_steps.purpose: To restore the skin's pH balance and prep it for further products.
To target existing breakouts and prevent new ones from forming.
To maintain skin hydration without clogging pores.

do: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water.
dont: Over-exfoliate, as this can irritate acne-prone skin.
Skip sunscreen; even if you are using a moisturizer with SPF, consider an additional application during the day.
common_mistakes: Using harsh scrubs that may irritate the skin and worsen acne conditions.
Not cleansing thoroughly enough before applying treatments or makeup.

expected_results.2_weeks: A reduction in visible breakouts and a decrease in redness.
expected_results.1_month: Improved skin texture, reduced inflammation, and clearer complexion.
expected_results.3_months: More balanced oil production, enhanced overall skin tone, and a noticeable improvement in the appearance of blemishes.

expert_tips: Always patch test new products before incorporating them into your routine to ensure you don't have an adverse reaction.
Consult with a dermatologist if your acne persists or worsens despite following this routine.
